description.value: Islands Bar — branded on the website as Islands Patio & Lounge — is the casual outdoor bar and lounge at Harrison Hot Springs Resort & Spa. It serves a relaxed food menu alongside a wide selection of wine, beer, and specialty cocktails on a patio overlooking the resort grounds. For touring cyclists exploring the Harrison Hot Springs area, it offers a scenic spot to wind down after a ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Islands Bar is an active, open bar and lounge at Harrison Hot Springs Resort & Spa, with a casual menu and outdoor patio. However, there is a name discrepancy: OSM uses 'Islands Bar' while the website consistently uses 'Islands Patio & Lounge.' No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so all amenity fields default to null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Islands Bar' but the resort website consistently calls it 'Islands Patio & Lounge'.
OSM opening hours (Mo-Su 15:00-21:45) differ from the website hours (Sun-Thu 12:00pm-10:00pm, Fri-Sat 12:00pm-11:00pm); website should be treated as more current.
No street address present in OSM record; business is located within Harrison Hot Springs Resort & Spa.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active bar and lounge at a well-known resort in the Harrison Hot Springs area, confirmed open by the resort website. Useful stop for touring cyclists in the region.
